subject: English
title: 英文第35題｜依原文找露營車受歡迎的原因
question:
What is the reason why RVs are popular today?
(A) People want to be their own boss.
(B) The house price is getting too high.
(C) People don’t want to live inside the house.
(D) They can save money by going to different places.
answer: (B) The house price is getting too high.
explanation:
全文逐句翻譯
當你因工作感到非常疲倦時，露營無疑是暫時遠離工作的一種好方法。然而，若想玩得愉快，應在去露營前做好一切準備。這就是許多人尋求露營車協助的原因。露營車像會移動的房子，可以帶你到世界上幾乎任何地方。
露營車的構想很早就出現。1915年，美國Conklin一家花好幾個月住在車內，開車從一座城市到另一座城市。他們把車布置得像家。車內有設備齊全的廚房、沙發與小花園。到1920年代中期，汽車公司看見需求增加，開始製造不同的移動住宅供人選擇。
直到今日，露營車已是這個時代的一種象徵。許多人不想因買昂貴房子而失去自由生活。因此，他們想為自己買露營車，因為車讓人能在路上工作並同時自由生活。總之，露營車不只是露營用汽車，也是戶外生活的好選擇。
原卷首句確實印is as a great way；原文照留，正常敘述此意應為is a great way，多出的as不照教成正確句型。

詳解
題目問今日受歡迎的原因，重點在第三段。very expensive house指房子非常昂貴，接續So說人們因而選擇露營車，保有自由。B最貼近這個原因，答案B。精確而言，本文說房屋昂貴，沒有另外呈現房價上漲過程；按四選項比較，B仍最合。
A把在路上工作擴成想當老闆，本文沒說創業。C把不想因購買昂貴房屋而失自由，改成不想住在房屋裡，改動原因。D把前往不同地方當作省錢方法，本文沒有建立這個因果關係。

free life在此是自由生活，不是免費生活。不能把文章曾出現的昂貴房屋與去不同地方，任意拼成去不同地方就能省錢。

快速判斷：回到第三段找very expensive house→So的因果，核對選項是否保留原文關係。首次圖漏D已由同串後續附件補齊，本題四選項完整。

passage:
When you feel too tired from your work, camping, for sure, is as a great way to run away from it for some time. However, if you want to have a great time, you should get everything ready before going camping. This is the reason why many people turn to RVs for help. An RV is like a moving house and takes you to almost everywhere in the world.

The idea of RVs started very early. In 1915, the Conklin family in the USA spent many months staying inside the car and driving from one city to another. They decorated their car just like a home. Inside it were a full kitchen, sofas and a small garden. By the mid-1920s, the car companies saw the growing need and started to make different moving homes for people to choose from.

Until now, RVs are a sign of our times. Many people don’t want to lose their free life by buying a very expensive house. So they would like to buy an RV for themselves because RVs allow them to work on the road and live freely at the same time. All in all, RVs are more than just a kind of car for camping, but they are a good choice for outdoor living.

原卷字詞：decorate裝飾；company公司；outdoor戶外的。

optionAnalysis.label: A
optionAnalysis.text: People want to be their own boss.
optionAnalysis.explanation: 原文說可在路上工作，未說要當老闆或創業。

optionAnalysis.label: B
optionAnalysis.text: The house price is getting too high.
optionAnalysis.explanation: 最貼近房子非常昂貴這個原因；文中未另證房價上升過程。

optionAnalysis.label: C
optionAnalysis.text: People don’t want to live inside the house.
optionAnalysis.explanation: 文章不是討厭房屋，而是不想為昂貴房屋失去自由。

optionAnalysis.label: D
optionAnalysis.text: They can save money by going to different places.
optionAnalysis.explanation: 文章未說移動到不同地方能使人省錢，因果無依據。
